title: perf(console): plugin-form and plugin-view helpers come from side-effect-free /core subpaths
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9QjKmMVoDWtE45ELv1652Kd)_

Part of #33581

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two new published `exports` subpaths, `@object-ui/plugin-form/core` and `@object-ui/plugin-view/core`; nothing removed or renamed, the package roots export the same names as before
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 做了什么：控制台首屏不再下载表单包和视图包。两个包各新增一个不注册任何东西的 `/core` 子路径，壳层只从它取辅助函数；表单和视图组件在第一次画出时才加载。
- 效果：首屏 eager 闭包 gzip 从 1,961,037 B 降到 1,909,225 B（−51,812 B，约 −2.6%）；plugin-form（44 KB）、plugin-view（16 KB）两块离开首屏，换进来两个小块（6.4 KB + 1.8 KB）。
- 用户可见的变化：一个会话里第一次打开记录表单、动作弹窗表单或流程表单步骤时，要等表单块下载完才显示；其余页面画出的内容不变。
- 没做的：卡里第 2 项（plugin-detail 的 11 处直取）不在本 PR。原因是 plugin-detail 有带订阅的模块级缓存，单独打一个 `/core` 包会在发布包里造出第二个实例，种子写不到根入口那一份；要改发布包的构建形状，需要席位定。plugin-grid 因此仍在首屏。
- 风险：公开面只加不减（两个新子路径）。九个测试套件原来顺着首屏图读到表单注册，需要改。另有两个 sideEffects 门禁测试对“无副作用的次入口”自相矛盾，做了窄口对齐，这超出了卡上写的文件范围。以上都逐个列在下面。
- 需要你做的：无；按惯例走契约复审后落地。

## What changes

**Two side-effect-free subpaths.** `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/plugin-view` register their renderers when their root entry is evaluated, and each root reaches every surface of its package. One pure helper imported from a root kept the whole package in the console's first load. Each package now publishes `/core` (ESM only, built by a second `vite build --config vite.core.config.ts` pass, the `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core` precedent), and it registers nothing:

- `plugin-form/core` (`src/core.ts`): `filterSystemFields`, `isAutoGeneratedFieldType`, `isWideFieldType`, `inferColumns`, `containerGridColsFor`, `resolveInlineMode`, `omitServerResolvedDefaults`, `optionListDefault`, `resolveSectionGroupReferences`, `useInitialFieldFocus`, plus their parameter types.
- `plugin-view/core` (`src/core.ts`): `deriveRecordSurface`, `deriveRecordFlowSurface`, `overlayWidthFor`, `toFilterGroup`, `deriveFieldOptions`, `isImageLikeField`, `isGeoLikeField`, `pickPreferredField`, the three `*_PREFERRED` lists, plus their types.

The roots still export every one of these names, unchanged. Both `sideEffects` arrays name the new entry form (`./src/core.ts`, `./dist/core.js`), as `check:side-effects-array` requires of every entry; its derived walk finds no registering module behind either.

**The shell takes its helpers from `/core`.** Eleven importers moved: `MetadataProvider`, `ActionParamDialog`, `ObjectFormDesigner`, `editFormLockedByState`, `SchemaForm`, the console's `FormPage`, `AppContent`, `objectViewRecordNavigation`, `userFilterUrlState`, `recordDrawerStack`, `CreateViewDialog`.

**Forms drawn outside a route load on first draw.** `views/lazyFormSurfaces.tsx` wraps `ModalForm` and `ObjectForm` in `lazy()` + `Suspense`. `AppContent` (the global record form), `useActionModal` (the action form) and `ScreenView` (a flow's object-form screen) draw through it.

**The console registers the two packages' tags as lazy stubs.** `register-plugins.ts` drops its eager `import '@object-ui/plugin-form'` / `'@object-ui/plugin-view'` and registers `object-form`, `embeddable-form`, `object-master-detail-form`, `view:form`, `record:line_items`, `object-view`, `view:simple`, `view-switcher`, `filter-ui`, `sort-ui` with `registerLazy`, each with the namespace, `skipFallback` and category its real registration declares. `check:sdui-registration-pins` confirms every promised registration is still in the built console.

**Bundling.** `apps/console/vite.config.ts` adds `plugin-form-core` and `plugin-view-core` groups at priority 71 with `includeDependenciesRecursively: false`, so the core modules do not land in (and drag in) the priority-70 package chunks. `ui/vitest.config.mts` aliases both `/core` subpaths to source, ahead of the bare package aliases.

## Why

Card #33581 item 1. Measured with #33677's method: a production build of the console, `dist/eager-closure.json`, gzip of the closure and of the five watched chunks (node `zlib.gzipSync`, the report's own level).

| | main `86350e12` | this head |
|:--|--:|--:|
| eager closure (100 chunks) | 1,961,037 B | 1,909,225 B (−51,812) |
| `plugin-grid` | 160,176 eager | 160,190 eager |
| `plugin-form` | 44,205 eager | 39,961 lazy |
| `plugin-view` | 16,051 eager | 19,776 lazy |
| `plugins-views` | lazy | 40,255 lazy |
| `RecordDetailView` | lazy | 23,139 lazy |
| `plugin-form-core` (new) | — | 6,438 eager |
| `plugin-view-core` (new) | — | 1,793 eager |

`check:eager-closure` passes on this head.

## Tests

- **New pin** `app-shell/src/__tests__/pluginCoreSubpaths-33581.test.ts` (3 tests). It reads the export names from the `/core` subpaths themselves, scans every non-test source under `app-shell/src` and `apps/console/src` (floors: >500 files, ≥10 `/core` importers), and fails when (a) any of them imports a `/core` name from a package entry, or (b) any of ten always-eager modules imports either entry by value, a bare import included.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proved by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):
  - `MetadataProvider.tsx`: `resolveInlineMode` from `'@object-ui/plugin-form'` → (a) and (b) both red, naming the file and the name.
  - `register-plugins.ts`: `import '@object-ui/plugin-detail'` → `import '@object-ui/plugin-view'` → (b) red: `bare import from '@object-ui/plugin-view'`.
- **Forced test edits** (each read a form or view registration through the old eager graph):
  - `apps/console/src/__tests__/masterDetailFormTypeManifest.test.ts`, `masterDetailFormI18nLabelManifest.test.ts`, `objectFormI18nLabelManifest.test.ts`, `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: `import '@object-ui/plugin-form'` beside `../register-plugins`, because a lazy stub carries no `inputs` and these read the manifest from `inputs` (the plugin-list precedent from PR 1).
  - `apps/console/src/__tests__/record-block-record-reach.test.tsx`: the same import; it renders `record:line_items` synchronously.
  - `apps/console/src/__tests__/public-contract.test.ts`: the same import; the reverse direction reads `record:line_items`'s `inputs`. `EXPECTED_LAZY` is unchanged.
  - `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.childWriteRefreshesParent-12244.test.tsx`: `import '@object-ui/plugin-grid'`. The related list renders through the registered `object-grid`; this page reached it only through plugin-view's entry (`ObjectView` imports plugin-grid). The console registers it in `register-plugins.ts`.
  - `app-shell/src/views/__tests__/FlowRunner.suspense.test.tsx`: the mocked `ObjectForm` was itself a `lazy()`; ScreenView now takes `ObjectForm` as the resolved value of its own `lazy()`, and React refuses a lazy that resolves to a lazy. The mock is now a component that renders an inner lazy body (still suspending on `formLoaded`), and the mocked package is loaded once before `FlowRunner` so its cold load does not eat `waitFor`'s budget.
  - `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ScreenPreview.test.tsx`: the two object-form tests `await screen.findByTestId('object-form')` instead of a synchronous `getByTestId`.
  - `ui/scripts/__tests__/side-effects-declaration-consistency.test.ts`: its phantom direction ("every declared source entry has a load-time side effect") contradicted `check-side-effects-array.mjs` and its own coverage direction, which both require every entry form in the array. A side-effect-free secondary entry (`src/core.ts`) could satisfy one only by failing the other. The phantom direction now skips secondary entry forms (exports subpaths other than the barrel) and still judges every barrel; a new anti-vacuity line pins that the exemption reaches the two `src/core.ts` and no `src/index.*`. Red before the edit (first gate run), green after.
  - `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-side-effects-array.test.ts`: the population pin "every package walks from exactly one root" now names the multi-entry population exactly: plugin-form and plugin-view, each `['src/core.ts', 'src/index.tsx']`. The gate walks both roots and finds the same single registrar as before.

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 2 (plugin-detail's eleven reach-ins) is not in this PR**, so it reads `Part of`. `queueClaim.ts`, `recordFieldAccess.tsx` and `useRecordEditable.ts` keep module-level caches with `subscribeDataChanges` subscriptions and sit in plugin-detail's `sideEffects` array. The shell seeds those caches (`seedQueueClaimDecision`, `seedRecordFieldAccess`, `seedRecordVerdict`). A `/core` built as a separate `dist/core.js` bundle, as here and in plugin-chatbot, would carry a second copy of each cache in the published package, so a seed written through core would never reach the hooks the root entry reads. Routing them needs a different published build shape (ES multi-entry with shared chunks, plus `sideEffects` globs), which is a package-shape choice for the seat. Item 2 would also need lazy stubs for plugin-grid's and plugin-detail's tags and a lazy `DevRowActions` (imported statically by `App.tsx`); only then does plugin-grid (160 KB) leave the first load. The detail-core closure measured at about 20 modules and contains no plugin-grid module.
- **`ModalForm` is not in `plugin-form/core`.** The card listed it with the helpers, but its closure is most of the form package, so `/core` would stop being small. The shell loads it from the entry through `lazy()` instead (`lazyFormSurfaces.tsx`).
- **Changeset is `patch`, not `minor`.** `Metadata-protocol: none` maps to `patch` under AGENTS.md's Post-Task Checklist step 3, and `check-changeset-no-major` refuses `minor` with `none`.
- **plugin-form's `/core` duplicates three warning-dedupe sets** (`reported`, `warnedHeadinglessCollapse`, `reportedCurrencyColumnScales`) in the published package. The worst case is a dev warning printed once more. No state the UI reads is duplicated. In the console, Vite resolves both to one source module, so nothing is duplicated there.
- **The FlowRunner suspension pin is now also covered by ScreenView's own boundary.** `LazyObjectForm` carries its own `Suspense`, so a form screen body's suspension stops inside the dialog even without FlowRunner's. The pin still proves the route-level fallback never shows.
- **File surface breach: `ui/scripts/__tests__/**`** (two forced edits above). The card's surface did not name the sideEffects gates' tests, and the two checks could not both pass on any `/core` subpath of an array package. The alternative was `sideEffects: true` for both packages (the plugin-chatbot shape), which gives up tree-shaking for every consumer of the two packages; I chose the narrow reconciliation. The seat can ask for the other.
- Surface outside the card's literal list, inside its "importers" clause: `apps/console/vite.config.ts` (chunk groups), `ui/vitest.config.mts` (aliases). Untouched per the claim's serial limits: plugin-view `ObjectView.tsx`, plugin-grid `ObjectGrid` and `src/index.tsx`.

## Verification

- Type-check: plugin-form, plugin-view, app-shell, console (`type-check`, including `tsconfig.test.json`) all exit 0.
- Affected suites: 462 files on the first pass; the 9 that went red are the forced edits above, and they pass after the edits.
- `pnpm --dir ui check:eager-closure`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:sdui-registration-pins`, `check:new-line-citations` exit 0. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (59 commands) run and reconciled with `--ran`: `59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 58 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`. The NOT-MEASURED one is `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, prerequisite: unbuilt server packages; left to CI).
- First-run reds, fixed and rerun on this head: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (the two sideEffects tests above; rerun 171 files passed), `check:dts-closure` (the console's `plugin.d.ts` was absent because the measurement build ran `vite build` only; after `build:plugin`, 228/228 present).
